what: From the photo stage pinned to the screen, the next photo panel is revealed by an elliptical mask centered outside the top right (105%, −10%). While the panel head moves 1000px down past the screen bottom, the revealed edge goes 110% → 0% (the 10% ahead of the edge fades transparent → 20% → opaque), the ellipse swells from 175% → 1200% wide and 230% → 1500% tall, and the photo settles from 1.06 → 1×. It is tied straight to scroll.

options.dist: Scroll distance at which it fully clears (px), default 1000
options.start: ScrollTrigger start, default top bottom — based on the panel top. In the original the second panel is top 110% and the fourth panel is top 60%
options.trigger: (optional) css of another element to measure progress — if a panel is overlaid on the stage, give that panel’s scene (the empty scrolling cell)

from.where: index.html .about__bg: the original about fixed background, radial-gradient(ellipse h v at 105% -10%, transparent → transparent at reveal-10% · .2 at reveal-5% · opaque at reveal). Over 1000px, reveal goes 110→0 · h 175→1200% · v 230→1500% · scale 1.06→1. The second panel is delayed by +.1vh and the fourth by −.4vh. Off on phones.
